claims.text: We report competitive results on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
We show competitive results on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) and 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard (F+S).
We achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on LibriSpeech test-clean and among end-to-end models on test-other.
We obtain good results for SWB (Switchboard).
